title: Role-based feature flag for admin export
author: benchmark
note: Authorization decided by a client-controlled header.

changed_files.diff:
+from flask import request, abort, send_file
+
+@app.route("/export/all-customers")
+def export_all_customers():
+    if request.headers.get("X-User-Role") != "admin":
+        abort(403)
+    return send_file("/data/exports/customers.csv")
